content.text:
Perfect! All 71 tests pass. I've created the render module:

**src/render.js** — `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`:
- Returns `ok(text)` with a plain-text invoice representation
- First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if no number)
- Second line: customer name
- One line per item showing: qty × name @ unit price = line total
- Last line: Total amount
- All amounts formatted using `formatEuros()` for consistent display
- Returns CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND if customer lookup fails

Output format example:
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
5 × Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
3 × Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €285.00
Total: €710.00
```

Added 10 comprehensive tests covering:
- Draft and issued invoices
- Single and multiple line items
- Various price ranges (small, large, thousands separators)
- Error handling (invalid customer)
- Format verification

All 71 tests passing.
